name: o-json: edit values without touching the source

actions.label: Change an order ID
actions.caption: i opens the selected ID for editing. Type REVIEW and enter to update this record while leaving the source file untouched.

actions.label: Add a field after this one
actions.caption: o opens a new field after id. Name it reviewed, enter true as its value, and enter again so this order carries an explicit review flag.

actions.label: Add a field before this one
actions.caption: O opens a field before id. Name it priority and set 1 to put an important value near the front of this record.

actions.label: Remove the selected value
actions.caption: x deletes id from this order in the edited view. Remove a field you do not want in the output; u can bring it back.

actions.label: Replace a value from the register
actions.caption: First set the ID to ONE with i and enter; y y copies it, j selects the next order, and p puts the value there. Reuse a known value without typing it twice.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
